title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Term Premium Components
content:
**NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — how a term's premium is built**

Every term's premium is booked as separate components:

| Component | How it is set |
|---|---|
| Risk Premium | The rated risk premium the Risk Rating 2.0 rating engine returned for the term |
| ICC Premium | The rated ICC premium the rating engine returned for the term |
| Federal Policy Fee | The rated Federal Policy Fee the rating engine returned |
| Reserve Fund Assessment | The tier's Reserve Fund Assessment percentage of the sum of the risk premium and ICC premium, rounded to the cent |
| HFIAA Surcharge | The tier's primary-residence HFIAA surcharge when the tier can carry the lower surcharge and the policy is designated a primary residence; the tier's other HFIAA surcharge in every other case |
| Probation Surcharge | Booked only when the community is on probation, at the tier's probation surcharge per term |

The desk never recalculates the risk premium, the ICC premium or the Federal Policy Fee. *Clause no longer in force:* "The HFIAA surcharge, the Federal Policy Fee and the probation surcharge are booked once per term at new business or renewal and never on an endorsement." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. A component of zero is not booked. The total term premium is the sum of the booked components and is shown to the customer as one amount due.

### HFIAA surcharge selection

| Tier can carry the lower surcharge | Policy designated a primary residence | HFIAA surcharge booked |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Primary-residence surcharge |
| Yes | No | Other surcharge |
| No | Yes | Other surcharge |
| No | No | Other surcharge |

### Hypothetical worked example

The figures are invented for illustration and are not rated figures of any policy. Suppose the engine returns a risk premium of 1,000.00 dollars, an ICC premium of 100.00 dollars and a Federal Policy Fee of 50.00 dollars, on a tier whose Reserve Fund Assessment percentage is 18 percent, for a primary-residence policy on a tier that can carry a 25-dollar primary-residence surcharge, in a community not on probation.
- Reserve Fund Assessment: 18 percent of 1,100.00 (the risk premium plus the ICC premium taken together) is 198.00.
- HFIAA Surcharge: 25.00. Probation Surcharge: not booked.
- Total term premium: 1,000.00 and 100.00 and 198.00 and 25.00 and 50.00 added together, that is 1,373.00, shown as one amount due.

superseded_clauses: The HFIAA surcharge, the Federal Policy Fee and the probation surcharge are booked once per term at new business or renewal and never on an endorsement.
